1.title: Trump Says Venezuelan Oil Will Refill U.S. Stockpiles, but It’s Not So Simple
1.summary: New projects can take years to produce meaningful amounts of oil, and that’s especially true in Venezuela, where infrastructure is in disrepair.

2.title: This Governor Could Lose His Primary. A Bridge May Be to Blame.
2.summary: The closure of a crucial Rhode Island bridge for safety reasons in 2023, and the traffic nightmare that followed, have dogged Gov. Dan McKee in the Democratic primary.

3.title: Climber Recounts Rescue From 6-Inch Ledge Atop California Mountain
3.summary: Rob Martin was stranded for hours before rescuers reached him. He recalled thinking: “One wrong move now, and that’s it. I die.”

4.title: Zambian opposition leader charged with treason
4.summary: Mundubile had previously gone into hiding at a United Nations building in Zambia's capital.

5.title: Google Maps Changes Lake Ontario to Lake America Following Trump’s Executive Order
5.summary: Users in the United States will see the new label, following President Trump’s executive order last week.

6.title: Russia says it helped to repel Niger attempted coup
6.summary: Soldiers tried to attack a key military base early on Saturday morning, authorities say, but were thwarted.
